exceptions.reason: MobSF 0.4.5 reads only the source manifest and defaults a missing uses-sdk target to 26. Gradle sets targetSdk = 37 for all app variants, confirmed in the merged debug manifest, so this rule's targetSdk < 29 precondition is false. This does not establish OS patch status or protection on older unpatched Android versions supported by minSdk 26.
findingSelectors: Activity exported, targetSdk<29 and launchMode != singleInstance or taskAffinity is not empty

exceptions.reason: Google Play purchase-data signatures use SHA1withRSA, as implemented in Google's TrivialDrive Security.java (https://dl.google.com/android/repository/play_billing_r05.zip). This code only verifies Play receipts with the application's public licensing key; changing the hash would reject those signatures. It does not sign production data or hash passwords. This protocol-compatibility exception does not establish general SHA-1 safety or live Play purchase validation.

This JVM-test fixture signs synthetic purchase receipts with an ephemeral RSA key generated in the test process. SHA1withRSA matches Google Play's purchase-data protocol and LocalPurchaseVerifier so tests exercise signature verification, tampering and wrong-key rejection. The fixture and its private key are not packaged in the application. Protocol reference: Google's TrivialDrive Security.java in https://dl.google.com/android/repository/play_billing_r05.zip.

This instrumented-test fixture signs a synthetic purchase receipt with an ephemeral RSA key to verify receipt persistence with Android crypto and DataStore. SHA1withRSA matches Google Play's purchase-data protocol and LocalPurchaseVerifier. It is test-only signing, not an application signing key or a real Play purchase. Protocol reference: Google's TrivialDrive Security.java in https://dl.google.com/android/repository/play_billing_r05.zip.
